capabilities: Import SDOCX files from an inbox folder as Excalidraw drawings
Export edited drawings back to their linked SDOCX files
Scan the inbox on demand and review pending imports
Verify a backup before replacing a linked SDOCX file
Warn about content that cannot round-trip, such as rotated text and audio or PDF objects
disambiguation: Not a one-way importer only; it also exports edited drawings back to the linked SDOCX files.
extras: The manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit Samsung Notes SDOCX files, so drawings exported from that app stay locked in a proprietary format.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later and Excalidraw 2.29.1 or later, enabled in the same vault.

summary: Imports Samsung Notes SDOCX exports as editable Excalidraw drawings and exports edited drawings back to linked SDOCX files, all on-device.
